query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.email.students
query.sql:
select s.dcid as studentdcid, s.lastfirst, listagg(ea.emailaddress, ',') within group (order by ea.emailaddress) as parentemails
from students s inner join studentcontactassoc sca on s.dcid = sca.studentdcid inner join studentcontactdetail scd on sca.studentcontactassocid = scd.studentcontactassocid and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(nvl(scd.startdate,sysdate)) and trunc(nvl(scd.enddate,sysdate)) inner join person p on sca.personid = p.id inner join codeset cr on scd.relationshiptypecodesetid = cr.codesetid inner join personemailaddressassoc peaa on peaa.personid = p.id inner join emailaddress ea on peaa.emailaddressid = ea.emailaddressid
where s.dcid in (:studentdcids) and ( lower(cr.code) like '%father%' or lower(cr.code) like '%mother%' ) and lower(cr.codetype) = 'relationship' and nvl(scd.isactive,0) = 1 and ea.emailaddress is not null
group by s.dcid, s.lastfirst

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.email.timeslots
query.sql:
select pt.id as timeslotid, pt.startdt, pt.enddt
from u_ptc5_timeslots pt
where pt.id in (:timeslotids)

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.email.sections
query.sql:
select e.dcid as sectiondcid, c.course_name, e.course_number||'.'||e.section_number as section_number, e.room
from sections e inner join courses c on e.course_number = c.course_number
where e.dcid in (:sectiondcids)

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.email.teachers
query.sql:
select t.dcid as schoolstaffdcid, t.lastfirst, hsp.room, hsp.onlineurl
from teachers t left outer join u_schoolstaff_ptc5 hsp on t.dcid = hsp.schoolstaffdcid
where t.dcid in (:schoolstaffdcids)

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.email.settings
query.sql:
select smtp_server, smtp_username, smtp_password, email_from, email_cc, email_bcc
from u_ptc5_settings
where rownum = 1
